name: Cloud Nine Set
description: Drift off in pure comfort with this 100% Egyptian cotton pajama set. Soft sky-blue with a delicate cloud print, relaxed fit top and wide-leg pants. Lightweight enough for year-round wear and cozy enough for those chilly nights.

name: Little Bears Set
description: Soft fleece two-piece set covered in cute bear faces on a warm pink background. Perfect for winter nights, with a kangaroo front pocket and cozy cuffs. Available in sizes 2–10 years.

name: Midnight Classic Set
description: A timeless men's pajama set in deep navy satin with fine grey pinstripes. Features a classic English collar shirt with natural shell buttons and relaxed lounge pants. Effortlessly polished for the discerning gentleman.

name: Starlight Set
description: Lightweight cotton kids' pajamas with a colorful star print on a soft lavender background. Gentle elasticized waistband that won't dig in during sleep. Great for spring and summer nights.

name: Garden Roses Set
description: Luxurious faux-silk two-piece with an English rose print in soft pink on a cream background. The adjustable waist tie and relaxed fit make this as elegant as it is comfortable. A timeless bedtime classic.

name: The Oxford Set
description: Premium striped cotton lounge set in soft grey and white. Includes a button-down shirt with a structured collar and relaxed drawstring trousers. Perfect for relaxing at home in style.

name: Dino Adventure Set
description: Fun cotton two-piece covered in cartoon dinosaurs on a bold green background — complete with a tiny dino tail detail on the back! Machine washable, soft, and built for wild imaginations.

name: Desert Bloom Set
description: A luxury double-layer muslin set in warm sand with delicate gold embroidery on the chest and sleeves. An effortlessly chic design that blends heritage craft with modern comfort.
